title: Annual Technical Fest (TechnoPulse) and Hackathons
content: TechnoPulse is the flagship national-level annual technical festival of Apex Institute, featuring 36-hour Hackathons, Robo-Wars, Project Exhibitions, Code Duels, Paper Presentations, and Drone Racing competitions with cash prizes over Rs 5,00,000. Over 3,000 engineering participants from across the country attend annually.
